title: Blush Belted Coat & Plaid Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, soft light brown hair falls past her shoulders and smiles gently. She wears a blush-pink wool coat with a belted waist, oversized sleeves, and a tartan plaid collar. Beneath it, a pleated tartan mini skirt and cream cable-knit tights. Her expression is warm and relaxed. A pale plaster backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of blush, camel, and cream. Sweet and layered, in the style of a winter boutique lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The blush coat and tartan collar create the soft contrast.
- Keep the cable-knit tights for a cozy winter layer.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the cable-knit tights for a cozy winter layer.
